verses.1: Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
verses.2: "Son of man, what is the vine tree compared to all the trees of the forest? Is it more valuable than the other trees of the woodland?
verses.3: Are they going to take wood from it to make a tool? Or take a peg from it to hang any object on?
verses.4: It is given to the fire to be consumed; its two ends are burned by the fire, and its middle is charred. Is it useful for any work?
verses.5: Even if it is whole and unbroken, it cannot be used for any work. Even if fire consumes it and chars it, is it still useful for any work?"
verses.6: Therefore, thus says the Lord GOD: "Just as the vine tree among the trees of the forest is given to the fire to be consumed, so I will give the residents of Jerusalem to the fire.
verses.7: I will set my face against them. They will come out from the fire, but the fire will devour them. Then you will know that I am the LORD when I set my face against them.
verses.8: I will make the land desolate, because they have acted treacherously," says the Lord GOD.

notes:
Notes  
- v. 3: "tool" renders "לִמְלָאכָה" (lit. "for work"), which is contextually best as a tool or implement, not a general "work."  
- v. 4: "middle is charred" captures "תוֹכוֹ נָחָר" — the core is burned through.  
- v. 6: "residents of Jerusalem" is a natural rendering of "יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם."
raw:
[1] Then the word of the LORD came to me, saying:  
[2] "Son of man, what is the vine tree compared to all the trees of the forest? Is it more valuable than the other trees of the woodland?  
[3] Are they going to take wood from it to make a tool? Or take a peg from it to hang any object on?  
[4] It is given to the fire to be consumed; its two ends are burned by the fire, and its middle is charred. Is it useful for any work?  
[5] Even if it is whole and unbroken, it cannot be used for any work. Even if fire consumes it and chars it, is it still useful for any work?"  
[6] Therefore, thus says the Lord GOD: "Just as the vine tree among the trees of the forest is given to the fire to be consumed, so I will give the residents of Jerusalem to the fire.  
[7] I will set my face against them. They will come out from the fire, but the fire will devour them. Then you will know that I am the LORD when I set my face against them.  
[8] I will make the land desolate, because they have acted treacherously," says the Lord GOD.  

---  
Notes  
- v. 3: "tool" renders "לִמְלָאכָה" (lit. "for work"), which is contextually best as a tool or implement, not a general "work."  
- v. 4: "middle is charred" captures "תוֹכוֹ נָחָר" — the core is burned through.  
- v. 6: "residents of Jerusalem" is a natural rendering of "יֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם."
